public.text: The section correctly states that architecture depends on people and institutions but does not distinguish permanent national capabilities from temporary project roles or external support.
public.suggestedRevision: Classify responsibilities as sovereign or accountable national functions, operational functions, specialist capabilities, and temporarily sourced support. Define which must remain institutionally owned.
